question: In 2025, what share of orders contained more than one item line? Compare average ordered units per order for one-line and multi-line orders; also report orders with no item line separately.

action.query:
SELECT
  CASE 
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT IS NULL THEN 'No item line'
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT = 1 THEN 'One item line'
    WHEN i.ITEM_LINE_COUNT > 1 THEN 'Multi item line'
  END AS ORDER_LINE_TYPE,
  COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_COUNT,
  SUM(o.SALES_QTY) AS TOTAL_ORDERED_UNITS,
  AVG(o.SALES_QTY) AS AVG_ORDERED_UNITS_PER_ORDER
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_ORDER_ITEM_ROLLUP i
  ON o.ORDER_ID = i.ORDER_ID
WHERE o.ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND o.ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ORDER_LINE_TYPE
ORDER BY 
  CASE ORDER_LINE_TYPE 
    WHEN 'No item line' THEN 0
    WHEN 'One item line' THEN 1
    WHEN 'Multi item line' THEN 2
    ELSE 3 END
action.metrics: order count, total ordered units, average ordered units per order by order line type (no item line, one item line, multi item line)
order count, share of orders, average ordered units per order by order line type (no item line, one item line, multi item line)
action.answer:
In 2025, there were no orders with zero item lines (no such row in the results). Out of all orders:

- 1,307,684 orders (29.99%) had exactly one item line, with an average of 1.219753 ordered units per order.
- 3,052,089 orders (70.01%) had more than one item line, with an average of 3.484769 ordered units per order.

Share of orders with more than one item line: 70.01% (3,052,089 out of 4,359,773 total orders).

Interpretation: Multi-line orders are the majority and have a much higher average number of units per order compared to single-line orders. No orders were found with zero item lines in 2025.
